newsitem.title: CANADA: UGG to supply canola for Canadian Agra crush.
newsitem.headline: UGG to supply canola for Canadian Agra crush.

text.p: United Grain Growers Ltd said on Wednesday it agreed in principle to a long-term deal to supply canola for Canadian Agra Foods Inc's two crush plants.
"Canadian Agra has demonstrated by its recent investment that it intends to be a force in the canola industry," UGG chief executive Brian Hayward said in a statement.

CAF is undertaking a C$10 million expansion of its Sexsmith, Alberta, crushing plant and is completing the first phase of a C$55 million double press, non-extraction canola crushing plant in Ste. Agathe, Manitoba. When the second phase is complete CAF will be the second largest crusher in Canada.
"This agreement builds on the strength of both firms," CAF chief executive Tony Cabral said in the statement.

CAF will be the only supplier of pure solvent-free canola oil in North America. The privately held firm said it has a market for the major portion of their canola cake through its relationship with a major European feed company.
